what_the_server_answers.command: tools/with-env uv run -q pytest -m md tests/destination/test_md.py
what_the_server_answers.reading: BEGIN is not sent to the server. The server lists a connection only while it has a statement in flight or a transaction with at least one statement, and an interrupt answers true in exactly those states. So the count `interrupted` of md.interrupt_earlier is the number of connections that held something, not the number of connections that are still alive, and a registered id of an idle connection cannot be told from one that is gone
